therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of gastrin-stimulated ECL cell proliferation and gastric carcinoid growth
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome and type II gastric carcinoids
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Regression of gastric carcinoids and/or ECL cell hyperplasia (25% reduction in size/number) and 25% reduction in gastric ECL cell density

results.effect_size: Mean carcinoid size reduction: Patient 1: 23.7%, Patient 2: 8.6%, Patient 3: 10.8%
results.target_engagement_evidence: Gastrin levels measured - Patient 1: 509-355 pg/mL, Patient 2: 13049-12846 pg/mL, Patient 3: 706-718 pg/mL
biomarker_changes: Chromogranin A levels varied: Patient 1: 2600-2700 ng/mL during treatment, 12300 ng/mL at follow-up
Patient 2: 11950-15350 ng/mL during treatment, 24100 ng/mL at follow-up
subgroup_findings: Patients 2 and 3 had minimal carcinoid regression (8.6% and 10.8%)
results.dose_information: Dose not specified in provided data
